text:
Maya (Mktg): Need a compact creative pack for an upcoming launch — drafts in 24h, finals in 48h. Deliverables: 1) benchmark micro-grid (mobile-first) with sparklines + 3 cols (Latency p50, Cost/1k, 8-word quality note), 2) social cards (1200x628 & 1080x1080) with two CTA variants for A/B, 3) webinar hero + 1-slide TL;DR, 4) email header (light/dark), 5) editable inbound routing diagram (SVG) showing canary splits and telemetry hooks, 6) 1-page brand/localization checklist with alt-text and strings CSV. Keep copy terse and mobile-friendly.

Ibrahim (Design): On it. Quick clarifications: sparklines OK as static PNGs plus optional animated SVG? Also confirm CTA copy examples.

Maya (Mktg): Static sparklines fine, include an animated SVG as optional. CTA variants: "See the numbers" and "Compare latency & cost". Make CTA its own component in Figma for swaps.

Zoe (Growth): Also request isolated CTA layer and 2x exports for socials. Provide a social carousel (3 cards) as an optional deliverable we can use in ads.

Priya (PMM): Legal notes: anonymize model names ("Model A/B/C"), avoid comparative claims without footnote, add small disclaimer: "Representative workloads; results may vary." Accessibility: include alt-text and contrast ratios in checklist. Localization: include a CSV with keys + EN/DE/JP columns and guidance on typical expansion percentages.

Ibrahim (Design): Deliverables: Figma page + PNG/2x exports + SVG diagram + animated sparkline GIF + checklist PDF + strings CSV. Specs: micro-row 36px mobile, sparklines 60x12, font Inter (600 model, 400 copy), color tokens from v2 palette. CTA safe zone 16px.

DesignOps Bot: Reminder: upload drafts to /shared/launch-assets/1745019876/drafts and finals to /shared/launch-assets/1745019876/final. Tag: "launchpack-1745". Set permissions: marketing+growth+design.

Ibrahim (Design): ETA drafts ~20h, finals 48h. Will ping with Figma link when drafts are up. :thumbsup:
